name: ArenaFileSelection
description: What a file input holds, as metadata: three parallel arrays in held order, so the file at one index in each is one file. Replaced whole on every change and never a delta. Parallel arrays are what an object of primitives can say about a list, so read them by index.

names.description: Each held file's name, as the platform reports it.

sizes.description: Each held file's size in bytes.

types.description: Each held file's media type, or an empty string when the platform reports none.
